name: REV-02
introduce:
REV-02 破晓者-02
由北陆联合与拉尼亚凯亚公司联合研发的轻型机兵。原本是作为下一代轻型钢岚机兵而研发的试验机兵，因研发途中出现了战略定位变化，而成为了为某位机师专门打造的特制机兵。为了适应目标驾驶员的驾驶习惯，REV-02采用了与常规单核心机兵完全不同的设计思路。REV-02在躯干与腿部采用了高兼容性的多态适应框架，能根据驾驶员的自身习惯临时编写对不同模组的操作系统，在确保兼容性的同时大幅提高了机兵模组的使用效率。

30278.name: Maverick Mod
30278.SpecificEffects:
When there are no allies within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles, DMG +<color=#F74848>18%</color>;
At start of action, if there are no allies within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles, AP cost of the first attack initiated this turn <color=#F74848>-1</color>, down to a minimum of <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

20394.name: Conflux Hub
20394.SpecificEffects: Doubles levels of modules slotted in Legs.

20393.name: Pressurized Accumulator
20393.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking, for every <color=#F74848>1</color> AP consumed, DMG +<color=#F74848>2.5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>10%</color>.

20392.name: Accurate Accumulator
20392.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking, for each <color=#F74848>1</color> AP consumed, Hit Rate +<color=#F74848>2.5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>10%</color>.

20391.name: Conflux Hub
20391.SpecificEffects: Doubles levels of modules slotted in Body.
